ambient_chatter.text: is it just me or did the fog over {village} smell like pickles xD
someone tell the bridge outside {town} i havent forgotten what it did. it knows :)
lag again?? the sacred chicken is fine, it just needs a nap :(
rain in {town} again. the clouds are clearly plotting against my button bank
reminder that {village} is officially renamed buttonvale. i will hear no objections :D

ambient_brag.text: my garrison at {fief} is {troop_count} strong and every one of them owes me a button xD
sitting on {gold} gold and the button bank keeps growing :)
{fief} is ours. the treaty was signed in buttons, no notes, no appeals xD
{troop_count} men, {gold} gold, one very loyal chicken. the realm trembles :)

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat me with {troop_count} men and i am choosing to call it a tactical nap xD
ser {player} fine, you win this one. the bank survives and so do i :)
{player}! you brought {troop_count} lads and still cant spell my name right. rematch at dawn xD
{player} beat us with {troop_count} men, honestly good game. my knees hurt from laughing :)
{player} you got lucky with {troop_count} men. next time i bring a bridge xD

beat_player.text: {player} went down with {troop_count} men and {gold} gold in the purse. the buttons won the day :)
{player} your {troop_count} men fled like the bridge owes them money. i will take the {gold} gold as a treaty fee xD
{player}! {troop_count} men down and {gold} gold to the button bank. stop sulking ser, its only a war :)
{player} lost {gold} gold and {troop_count} lads to me today. sorry not sorry xD
{player} that was a fine fight. keep the {troop_count} lads you have left, i only want the gold :)

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} running away already? the bridge would be proud of you :)
{player} saw my banner and ran. the button bank sends its regards xD
ser {player} come back, i promise the buttons are only mildly cursed :(
{player} fled like a goose that owes me rent. tragic, truly :(
{player} you can run but the chicken will always find you xD

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won like nine in a row. i am not jealous, i am simply preparing a nap for them xD
ser {player} enjoy the streak, every streak ends at a bridge eventually :)
{player} on a winning streak and i have never been prouder. proud button tears are real :')
{player} your streak ends at my button bank, mark my words. the chicken has been warned xD
is {player} still winning? someone check if they have a button bank of their own :)

peace_made.text: peace between {my_faction} and {faction} is signed, which means i can finally stop running from a certain goose xD
{my_faction} and {faction} made peace. the buttons were involved, obviously :)
treaty of {my_faction} and {faction} done. no more fighting, just gossip and tiny hats xD
{faction} wants peace with {my_faction}? i accept on behalf of the chicken :D

war_declared.text: {enemy_faction} has declared war on {my_faction}. the buttons have been drawn and i am already sad about it :(
war with {enemy_faction}! {my_faction} forms a line, the chicken is in front xD
{enemy_faction} wants a fight with {my_faction}? cool, i will bring the whole button bank :)
the fine people of {enemy_faction} have chosen violence. i respect it, i will still win xD

encounter_greeting.text: {player}! its {persona} of {my_faction}. you stand between me and my button bank, which is a crime. stand down xD
oh hello {player}, {persona} here. you look like you lost a bet, want a button for your trouble :)
{player}! my favorite person in the whole realm. {persona} is so glad to see you, the chicken agrees :D
{player} you again. {persona} of {my_faction} has been dreaming of this moment, possibly about buttons xD
ser {player}, {persona} salutes you! if you ever need a loyal button you know where i keep them :)

whisper_taunt.text: {player} your lot is weaker than my button bank and that is saying something xD
ser {player} i heard {rival} said you lost. i will wait while you cry into your hat :)
{player} the chicken has seen your banner and it finds it tacky :P
{player} keep waving that banner, i can see it from the bridge xD
hey {player}, {rival} said you were scary. i am still waiting for the scary part :)
